q: 急がば回れ

tr.id: Kalau terburu-buru, ambil jalan memutar (pelan tapi pasti).
tr.en: If you're in a hurry, take the long way round.

q: 習うより慣れよ

tr.id: Lebih baik membiasakan diri daripada cuma belajar teori.
tr.en: Getting used to it beats merely learning it.

q: 石の上にも三年

tr.id: Duduk tiga tahun di atas batu pun akan hangat: sabar akan berbuah.
tr.en: Even a cold stone warms up after three years: persistence pays.

q: 猿も木から落ちる

tr.id: Monyet pun bisa jatuh dari pohon: yang ahli juga pernah salah.
tr.en: Even monkeys fall from trees: experts make mistakes too.

q: 失敗は成功のもと

tr.id: Kegagalan adalah akar keberhasilan.
tr.en: Failure is the root of success.

q: 好きこそ物の上手なれ

tr.id: Apa yang kita sukai, itulah yang akan kita kuasai.
tr.en: We get good at what we love.

q: 百聞は一見に如かず

tr.id: Melihat sekali lebih baik daripada mendengar seratus kali.
tr.en: Seeing once beats hearing a hundred times.

q: 案ずるより産むが易し

tr.id: Dijalani ternyata lebih mudah daripada dikhawatirkan.
tr.en: Doing it is easier than worrying about it.

q: 雨降って地固まる

tr.id: Setelah hujan, tanah jadi lebih padat: masalah membuat kita lebih kuat.
tr.en: After the rain, the ground hardens.

q: 一期一会

tr.id: Satu pertemuan, satu kesempatan: hargai tiap momen.
tr.en: One time, one meeting: treasure every moment.

q: 初心忘るべからず

tr.id: Jangan pernah lupakan semangat pemula.
tr.en: Never forget your beginner's mind.

q: 為せば成る

tr.id: Kalau dikerjakan, pasti jadi.
tr.en: If you do it, it will be done.

q: 備えあれば憂いなし

tr.id: Kalau sudah siap, tidak perlu khawatir.
tr.en: If you are prepared, there is nothing to fear.

q: 天は自ら助くる者を助く

tr.id: Tuhan menolong mereka yang menolong dirinya sendiri.
tr.en: Heaven helps those who help themselves.

q: 光陰矢の如し

tr.id: Waktu berlalu secepat anak panah.
tr.en: Time flies like an arrow.

q: 後悔先に立たず

tr.id: Penyesalan tidak pernah datang lebih dulu.
tr.en: Regret never comes first.

q: 十人十色

tr.id: Sepuluh orang, sepuluh warna: tiap orang berbeda.
tr.en: Ten people, ten colours.

q: 笑う門には福来たる

tr.id: Rumah yang penuh tawa akan didatangi keberuntungan.
tr.en: Fortune comes to the house that laughs.

q: 良薬は口に苦し

tr.id: Obat yang manjur itu pahit: nasihat baik sering terasa tidak enak.
tr.en: Good medicine tastes bitter.

q: 能ある鷹は爪を隠す

tr.id: Elang yang pandai menyembunyikan cakarnya.
tr.en: A skilled hawk hides its talons.

q: 三人寄れば文殊の知恵

tr.id: Tiga orang berkumpul menghasilkan kebijaksanaan.
tr.en: Three heads together have the wisdom of Manjushri.

q: The limits of my language mean the limits of my world.
Learn a new language and get a new soul.
To have another language is to possess a second soul.
Language is the road map of a culture.
One language sets you in a corridor for life. Two languages open every door along the way.
He who does not know foreign languages does not know anything about his own.
A different language is a different vision of life.
Without grammar very little can be conveyed; without vocabulary nothing can be conveyed.
Repetition is the mother of learning.
To learn a language is to have one more window from which to look at the world.
Language is the dress of thought.
The more languages you know, the more you are human.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
What stands in the way becomes the way.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
No man is free who is not master of himself.
Well begun is half done.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
Do not seek to follow in the footsteps of the wise. Seek what they sought.
Do nothing which is of no use.
Think lightly of yourself and deeply of the world.
Pain is inevitable. Suffering is optional.
The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
It always seems impossible until it is done.
Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.
Small deeds done are better than great deeds planned.
Motivation gets you started. Habit keeps you going.
Amateurs sit and wait for inspiration, the rest of us just get up and go to work.
Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.
Well done is better than well said.
Energy and persistence conquer all things.
Rome wasn't built in a day.
Every expert was once a beginner.
Slow is smooth, smooth is fast.
Inch by inch, life's a cinch. Yard by yard, life is hard.
Do the hard jobs first. The easy jobs will take care of themselves.
Success represents the 1% of your work which results from the 99% that is called failure.
It's not that I'm so smart, it's just that I stay with problems longer.
A journey is best measured in friends, rather than miles.
The best way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
A goal without a plan is just a wish.
Fall in love with the process, and the results will come.
Make it work, make it right, make it fast.
Premature optimization is the root of all evil.
Simplicity is a prerequisite for reliability.
Programs must be written for people to read, and only incidentally for machines to execute.
Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
Any fool can write code that a computer can understand. Good programmers write code that humans can understand.
Perfection is achieved not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.
Code is like humor. When you have to explain it, it's bad.
First, solve the problem. Then, write the code.
There are only two hard things in computer science: cache invalidation and naming things.
The function of good software is to make the complex appear to be simple.
Measuring programming progress by lines of code is like measuring aircraft building progress by weight.
Walking on water and developing software from a specification are easy if both are frozen.
The first 90 percent of the code accounts for the first 90 percent of the development time. The remaining 10 percent accounts for the other 90 percent.
A language that doesn't affect the way you think about programming is not worth knowing.
Good code is its own best documentation.
Before software can be reusable it first has to be usable.
Experience is the name everyone gives to their mistakes.
